# Procedure Codes

This folder contains specific medical procedure codes used within the Danish healthcare system to identify and track various types of echocardiography examinations. Registered in the Sygesikringsregisteret (National Health Service Register) and the Landspatientregisteret (National Patient Register), these codes cover standard, advanced, stress, transesophageal, and contrast-enhanced cardiac ultrasounds. They are essential for the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) to calculate clinical quality indicators, ensuring that patients with atrial fibrillation receive timely and evidence-based diagnostic imaging.

## Pages

- [[0906-ekko-kardiografi|0906 Ekko-kardiografi]] — Procedure code in the Sygesikringsregisteret for identifying echocardiographic examinations in atrial fibrillation quality tracking.
- [[2208-ekkocardiografi|2208 Ekkocardiografi]] — Health Insurance Register code used to track general echocardiography exams for cardiovascular quality measurement.
- [[3810-ekkocardiografi-standardundersoegelse|"3810 Ekkocardiografi, standardundersøgelse"]] — Designates standard echocardiographic examinations within the national clinical quality indicators.
- [[3811-ekkocardiografi-avanceret-undersoegelse|"3811 Ekkocardiografi, avanceret undersøgelse"]] — Identifies advanced echocardiography exams, distinguishing them from standard procedures in registry data.
- [[5101-ekko-cardiografi|5101 EKKO-cardiografi]] — Tracks whether atrial fibrillation patients receive necessary echocardiographic evaluations as part of diagnostic follow-up.
- [[5102-transsofageal-ekko|5102 Transsøfofagal ekko.]] — Specific code for transesophageal echocardiography procedures in the national health registers.
- [[5103-stress-ekkocardiogra|5103 Stress ekkocardiogra]] — Identifies stress echocardiography examinations for monitoring diagnostic workups.
- [[6402-ekkocardiografi|6402 Ekkocardiografi]] — Medical procedure code used alongside others to capture the full scope of cardiac ultrasound procedures.
- [[6408-ekkocardiografi|6408 Ekkocardiografi]] — Registry code utilized to define clinical indicators evaluating diagnosis and follow-up care for atrial fibrillation.
- [[uxuc80|UXUC80]] — Landspatientregisteret code designating standard transthoracic echocardiography for Indicator 2 compliance.
- [[uxuc80a|UXUC80A]] — Designates transthoracic stress echocardiography in the National Patient Register.
- [[uxuc80b|UXUC80B]] — Identifies transthoracic echocardiography performed with a dobutamine test.
- [[uxuc80c|UXUC80C]] — Tracks transthoracic echocardiography with contrast for standardized cardiovascular data collection.
- [[uxuc80d|UXUC80D]] — Designates transthoracic 3-D echocardiography within the clinical quality metrics.
- [[uxuc80e|UXUC80E]] — Identifies transthoracic echocardiography with tissue Doppler imaging.
- [[uxuc81|UXUC81]] — Designates transesophageal echocardiography, crucial for evaluating stroke risk in atrial fibrillation patients.
- [[uxuc81c|UXUC81C]] — Tracks transesophageal echocardiography performed with contrast.
